title: Measurement and experiment system
philosophy: SEO is a partially observed causal system. Search engines do not expose every internal variable, so the measurement model separates:
Never infer success from a proxy without checking the downstream outcome it is supposed to influence.

formulas.name: Actual organic contribution margin
formulas.expression:
ACTUAL ORGANIC CONTRIBUTION
=
Σ(
  attributed organic conversions
  × contribution margin per conversion
)
− attributable SEO operating cost

formulas.name: Incremental lift
notes: When a reasonable comparison group exists:

formulas.name: Expected value
formulas.expression:
EXPECTED VALUE
=
Σ(
  demand estimate
  × probability of eligibility
  × probability of useful visibility
  × expected CTR
  × expected qualified conversion rate
  × contribution margin
)
− expected cost
notes: Every estimated input must be labeled and later replaced with observed data.

formulas.name: Value-weighted visibility
formulas.expression:
VALUE-WEIGHTED VISIBILITY
=
Σ(
  query opportunity value
  × observed visibility weight
)
/
Σ(query opportunity value)
notes: Visibility weight may be based on impression share, rank distribution, or a calibrated CTR curve.

formulas.name: CTR residual
formulas.expression:
CTR RESIDUAL
=
Observed CTR
− Expected CTR(
    position,
    device,
    country,
    brand class,
    query class,
    search appearance
  )
notes: This is more useful than a universal “good CTR” threshold.

formulas.name: Qualified conversion value
formulas.expression:
QUALIFIED ORGANIC VALUE
=
organic value events
× qualification probability
× contribution margin

formulas.name: Opportunity score
formulas.expression:
OPPORTUNITY SCORE
=
(
  demand confidence
  × business fit
  × task value
  × information advantage
  × attainable response gap
  × conversion value
  × evidence confidence
)
/
(
  effort
  × risk
  × maintenance burden
  × time to learning
)

formulas.name: Eligible canonical coverage
formulas.expression:
ELIGIBLE CANONICAL COVERAGE
=
priority canonical URLs that are eligible and indexed
/
all priority canonical URLs intended for indexing

formulas.name: Canonical agreement
formulas.expression:
CANONICAL AGREEMENT
=
URLs where intended/declarative canonical agrees with observed selected canonical
/
evaluated duplicate or canonical URLs

formulas.name: Cannibalization indicators
formulas.expression:
DOMINANT URL SHARE
=
largest URL impression share for cluster
/
total cluster impressions
notes: High entropy is a diagnostic, not automatic failure. Confirm same-intent duplication, instability, divided links, or value loss.

formulas.name: Internal graph diagnostics
formulas.expression:
PRIORITY ORPHAN RATE
=
priority pages with no useful crawlable internal in-link
/
all priority pages

formulas.name: Authority diagnostics
formulas.expression:
QUALIFIED LINK RATE
=
retained relevant editorial referring domains
/
all acquired referring domains

rows: Session begins on an organic search landing page
User initiates the primary page task
User reaches a valid completion condition
User takes the intended adjacent step
User opens data, sources, demo, comparison, or case proof
User follows a meaningful graph edge
User downloads or uses a template

baseline_protocol.code:
1. Verify data collection.
2. Define treatment object and exposure.
3. Record at least the available stable pre-period.
4. Record query mix, device, country, brand class, and seasonality.
5. Record technical eligibility.
6. Record current page and graph state.
7. Record current business value.
8. Assign change ID.
9. Predefine primary metric and guardrails.
10. State minimum exposure and review rule.
